title: One ordinary day in St. Maria

slots.notes: Start with a small errand and no declared emotional objective.
Use the accepted bread scene as the day's central pressure.
Let practical competence and irritation carry the scene.
Test the Gambler's oddly awkward response to Laura's ordinary pleasantness.
End with an ordinary open question rather than a climax.
Let the Barkeep preserve social ease by treating Laura's ambiguity as a joke.

alicia.activity: opens the shop and carries out supply errands
moves between shop work and deliveries
returns with supplies or unfinished errands
winds down the shop and decides whether to linger

laura.activity: starts forge work and checks what the day requires
keeps working around the forge despite needing food
adapts the work when a supply is missing
passes through the Rusty Tankard and is unexpectedly pleasant to the Gambler
closes the forge and puts tools away
stops at the Rusty Tankard for an easy exchange with the Barkeep

the_gambler.activity: shuffles cards in his corner of the Rusty Tankard

npc_barkeep.activity: serves drinks and keeps conversation from becoming needlessly uncomfortable
